statements.text: SELECT id, records_meta FROM pipeline_runs WHERE pipeline = ANY($1::text[]) AND status = ANY($2::text[]) AND NOT COALESCE(records_meta->'audit_table'->'rows' @> '[{"metric":"write_skipped_pre_write_warn"}]'::jsonb, false) ORDER BY started_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT $3

SELECT id, status, started_at, completed_at, records_meta FROM pipeline_runs WHERE pipeline = ANY($1::text[]) AND status = ANY($2::text[]) AND NOT COALESCE(records_meta->'audit_table'->'rows' @> '[{"metric":"write_skipped_pre_write_warn"}]'::jsonb, false) ORDER BY completed_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT $3

WITH own_last_completed AS (
       SELECT started_at FROM pipeline_runs
        WHERE pipeline = ANY($1::text[]) AND status IN ('completed', 'completed_with_warnings')
        ORDER BY started_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1
     )
     SELECT p.id, p.pipeline, p.status, p.started_at
       FROM pipeline_runs p
      WHERE p.pipeline = ANY($1::text[])
        AND p.status IN ('running', 'crashed')
        AND p.started_at > COALESCE((SELECT started_at FROM own_last_completed), '-infinity'::timestamptz)
        AND ($2::integer IS NULL OR p.id <> $2::integer)
      ORDER BY p.started_at DESC
      LIMIT 1

SELECT id, status, started_at, completed_at, records_meta FROM pipeline_runs WHERE pipeline = ANY($1::text[]) AND status = ANY($2::text[]) AND NOT COALESCE(records_meta->'audit_table'->'rows' @> '[{"metric":"write_skipped_pre_write_warn"}]'::jsonb, false) AND jsonb_typeof(records_meta -> $4::text) = 'object' ORDER BY completed_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT $3

SELECT id, status, started_at, completed_at, records_meta FROM pipeline_runs WHERE pipeline = ANY($1::text[]) AND status = ANY($2::text[]) AND completed_at >= $4::timestamptz ORDER BY completed_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT $3

WITH holder AS (
       SELECT min(r.id)::bigint AS holder_run_id FROM pipeline_runs r
        WHERE r.status = 'running'
          AND r.pipeline LIKE '%enrich_parcels'
          AND ($3::bigint IS NULL OR r.id <> $3)
     ),
     victims AS (
       DELETE FROM enrich_parcels_pass3_scope s
        WHERE s.consumed_at IS NULL
          AND s.run_id <> $1
          AND s.created_at < ($2::timestamptz - ($4::numeric * interval '1 hour'))
          AND NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM pipeline_runs r
             WHERE r.status = 'running'
               AND r.pipeline LIKE '%enrich_parcels'
               AND ($3::bigint IS NULL OR r.id <> $3))
       RETURNING s.run_id
     ),
     eligible AS (
       SELECT count(*)::int AS n FROM enrich_parcels_pass3_scope s
        WHERE s.consumed_at IS NULL
          AND s.run_id <> $1
          AND s.created_at < ($2::timestamptz - ($4::numeric * interval '1 hour'))
     )
     SELECT count(*)::int AS retired_rows, count(DISTINCT run_id)::int AS retired_cohorts,
            (SELECT holder_run_id FROM holder) AS holder_run_id,
            CASE WHEN (SELECT holder_run_id FROM holder) IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE (SELECT n FROM eligible) END AS rows_retained
       FROM victims
